invented.quote: Each book also takes me about four months of full-time work.
invented.why: The brief says each book takes about four months, but does not state that it is full-time work.

invented.quote: My fees elsewhere have gone up as well.
invented.why: The brief mentions one fee of $12,500 from another publisher last year, not that the illustrator's fees at other publishers have increased over time.

invented.quote: Last year another publisher paid me $12,500 for a 32-page book of the same scope.
invented.why: The brief states the other book was of the 'same length' (32 pages), but does not say it had the same scope (such as having 14 full spreads).

invented.quote: That's toward the lower end of that range, because I value working with you and want to keep making books together.
invented.why: The brief states the desired fee is $11,500, but does not give a reason for choosing a number at the lower end of the agent's range.
